brand.tagline: No More Struggles. All Solutions Within Reach.
brand.mission: To connect schools, food suppliers, cooperatives, and institutions through accessible solutions and intelligent technology that make food sourcing, supply management, and school meal planning easier, smarter, and more efficient.
brand.vision: To create a future where every school can access the food it needs, suppliers can reach the markets they serve, and the entire school food system operates through reliable connections, informed decisions, and intelligent solutions.
